name: draft
title: Entity: Draft
description: Prepared pre-publication marketplace entity used to create published listings.
text:
# Draft

TL;DR:
- Draft is the prepared version of a listing before publication.
- The app workflow usually builds a listing through a draft, but seller.listingCreate can also publish directly without one.
- Draft still remains the canonical seller editing model.

What it is:
- A draft is the seller-side preparation model for a future listing.

What it is used for:
- It is used to edit, validate, and prepare marketplace content before publication.

Relationships:
- draft -> listing (publication when publish uses a draft)
- draft -> gallery
- draft -> category
- draft -> location

Role note:
- Draft belongs to seller workflow, not buyer browsing workflow.

Agent hint:
- If the task is about preparing or editing content before it becomes public, think draft first. Use direct listing create only when a one-shot publish is intentional.
